summary: Converts six normalized floats from `this` into 16-bit output words written through the a2 pointer. The first four floats (this[0..3], e.g. RGBA channels) are scaled by 65535.0 and converted with CRTFtol; the last two floats (this[4], this[5], e.g. intensity/extra channels) are scaled by 128.0. The truncated value of this[4]*128.0 is also the function return value. Called by sub_4FCEE0.

local_names.a2: destination pointer for the six 16-bit outputs

operations.description: Write CRTFtol(this[0] * 65535.0) into output word a2[0].
Write CRTFtol(this[1] * 65535.0) into output word a2[1].
Write CRTFtol(this[2] * 65535.0) into output word a2[2].
Write CRTFtol(this[3] * 65535.0) into output word a2[3].
Scale this[4] by 128.0, truncate to an integer, save it as the return value, and write it into output word a2[4].
Scale this[5] by 128.0, truncate to an integer, and write it into output word a2[5].
Return the truncated this[4]*128.0 value as the 16-bit signed result.
Invoked by sub_4FCEE0 (004fcee0) to convert float color data to packed 16-bit words.
